title: Rethinking Joint Maximum Mean Discrepancy for Visual Domain Adaptation

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The matrix M^H, which appears in the concise HSIC (Eq. 4), in the graph embedding interpretation (L^H = K^4 ⊙ M^H), and in the final JMMD-HSIC loss (Eq. 9), is introduced without any definition. No explicit entry values are provided in the main text or in the appendix. This omission makes the entire HSIC-based part of the method incomplete and unreproducible.

Table 1 reports OGL2P+JMMD-HSIC average accuracy as 90.1 on Office-31, while Table 3 (ablation) and the textual claims (e.g., '0.8% improvements on the two datasets' for OGL2P baseline and '0.3% ... improvements over the second-best method, i.e., RSDA-MSTN') imply a figure of 91.5 (90.7 + 0.8). The data in Table 1 conflicts with both the ablation table and the narrative, indicating a likely data entry error or misreporting.

predicted_errors.error_location: Abstract and Introduction (second paragraph of Introduction)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The abstract states that the proposed deduction 'avoids the tensor-product operator', but the Introduction later warns: 'the exact elimination of the tensor product remains an open problem, and derivative calculations require further careful analysis beyond the scope of this work.' These two statements contradict each other and overstate the completeness of the solution.

The label kernel K^1 is written as 'I_{n×n}', which normally denotes the identity matrix, but the text describes it as 'a matrix whose elements are all 1'. This notational error could cause confusion and should be corrected to 1_{n×n} (or a bold 1).

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 3.4, Eq. (8) and surrounding graph embedding interpretation
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The paper claims that the JMMD and HSIC losses can be rewritten as ∑ w_{ij}‖B^⊤ k_i^{XX} − B^⊤ k_j^{XX}‖_F^2 with the defined weights, without verifying that K^2⊙M^J and K^4⊙M^H satisfy the required Laplacian (zero row-sum) property. The derivation is missing, and the equivalence is not established. This weakens the graph embedding motivation and the claimed insight about discrimination degradation.
